name: Richa Singh
headline: Associate AI/ML Engineer | Machine Learning | Computer Vision | Predictive Analytics
about: Associate AI/ML Engineer within 8-12 months of experience in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Data Analytics. Skilled in Python, YOLO, LLMs, SQL, and Streamlit, with hands-on experience in object detection, predictive analytics, and real-time risk assessment. Passionate about developing practical AI solutions.

responsibilities: Collected, organized, and labeled project data; prepared structured datasets for YOLO-based object detection.
Performed data preprocessing, dataset quality analysis, and data validation to support data accuracy and consistency.
Trained YOLO models, experimented with training approaches, and evaluated results to improve model performance.
Fine-tuned models and identified effective configurations to support computer vision model development.
Worked on burnout risk prediction using machine learning and predictive analytics in a healthcare analytics context.
Contributed to real-time risk assessment, a Streamlit application, and model deployment.
Used Python, SQL, Excel, and Power BI for data analysis, visualization, and analytical reporting.
Worked with interactive dashboards, business intelligence, and academic analytics to support data-driven decision-making.

education.degree: Master of Computer Applications (Data Science & AI)
education.description: My AI journey began at Babu Banarasi Das University (BBDU) during my MCA in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Here, I learned the fundamentals of AI, its practical applications, and how to use AI technologies to solve real-world problems.

My computer science journey began at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith University, where I completed my Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA). This is where I took my first steps into the world of computers, learning the fundamentals of computer science, programming, and software development, which laid the foundation for my future in technology and AI.

projects.name: Parashara Software

projects.name: YOLO-Based Computer Vision & Floor Plan Detection
projects.description: Worked on real-world Computer Vision projects using YOLO for object detection and segmentation. Developed solutions for floor-plan analysis, including wall and room detection, with image preprocessing, annotation validation, model training, and testing.

projects.name: Burnout Risk Prediction
projects.description: Worked on machine learning-based burnout risk prediction with predictive and healthcare analytics, real-time risk assessment, a Streamlit application, and model deployment.

projects.name: Autism Prediction System
projects.description: Built a machine learning-based tool using XGBoost and Random Forest to predict autism likelihood from behavioral and demographic data. Enabled early-stage detection with a focus on under-resourced areas. Tools used: Python, machine learning algorithms, and Jupyter Notebook.
